style: Japanese cel-shaded anime sci-fi game UI concept art, crisp clean line work, flat two-tone hard-edged shading with absolutely NO soft gradients and NO bloom and NO lens flare, hard-surface precision instrument design, placeholder text rendered as blank flat bars with no readable letters or numbers, no logo, no watermark, no real words

assets.prompt: Mobile portrait game HUD mockup for a sci-fi tower defense, restrained military-specification instrument panel look. Layout: three stacked horizontal info plates in the top-left corner, three circular buttons stacked vertically along the left edge, one wide action card in the bottom-left, a horizontal segmented health bar in the bottom center, one large circular button in the bottom right. Panels are FLAT COLD WHITE plates in the exact same cool blue-white tone as white mecha armour, matte with no highlight, each bordered by a single hairline charcoal line, one thin cyan indicator strip per plate, tiny etched panel seam lines and small bracket marks instead of any glow. Shallow 45-degree chamfered corners, no rivets, no bevels. Almost no glow anywhere, only the thin cyan indicators emit light. Background: dark deep space battlefield with a faint purple lane, darkened so the white plates dominate. Calm, orderly, extremely low visual noise, reads well at small sizes.

Mobile portrait game HUD mockup for a sci-fi tower defense, restrained military-specification instrument panel look built on a hard two-tone split. Layout: three stacked horizontal info plates in the top-left corner, three circular buttons stacked vertically along the left edge, one wide action card in the bottom-left, a horizontal segmented health bar in the bottom center, one large circular button in the bottom right. Every panel is divided horizontally into two FLAT solid tones by a single hard straight edge with no gradient: cool white on the upper portion and pale cool grey on the lower portion, exactly like two-tone cel shading on armour. Background: dark deep space battlefield with a faint purple lane, darkened. Graphic and flat, reads like stencilled military markings.

Background: dark deep space battlefield with a faint purple lane, darkened. Extremely clean, silent, near-paper flat graphic design.

Mobile portrait game HUD mockup for a sci-fi tower defense, restrained military-specification instrument panel look focused on fine ENGRAVED detail. Layout: three stacked horizontal info plates in the top-left corner, three circular buttons stacked vertically along the left edge, one wide action card in the bottom-left, a horizontal segmented health bar in the bottom center, one large circular button in the bottom right. Panels are FLAT COLD WHITE plates in the same cool blue-white tone as white mecha armour, matte, each with a single hairline charcoal border. All the detail is etched and flat, no raised bevel, no rivet heads, no glow except the indicators. Shallow chamfered corners. Background: dark deep space battlefield with a faint purple lane, darkened. Technical, precise, quiet but not empty.
